_readme: Registry of objects available in the Map Generator. To add a new object: put the .glb file under src/model/ (e.g. src/model/map/tree/pine.glb) and add an entry to 'objects'. 'model' is the path relative to src/model/. Optional per-object fields: 'scale' (fixed scale; if omitted the model is auto-fitted so its largest side is 'size' units), 'size' (auto-fit size, default 10), 'yOffset' (lift above ground), 'rotationY' (default heading in degrees), 'defaultAnimation' (animation clip name played by default). GLB files under src/model/map/ that are NOT listed here are still auto-detected and shown in the category matching their folder.
